description: Test helpers for Mafesoft.RestClient: a fake server (RestTest) that intercepts the requests of Rest.Build() and of IRestClientFactory, with configurable responses and call assertions. Test framework agnostic.

Opt-in CBOR Web Tokens (CWT, RFC 8392) for NCode.Identity over its COSE library: issuance as COSE_Sign1 or COSE_Mac0, optionally inside COSE_Encrypt0 or COSE_Encrypt, and fail-closed validation of algorithms, keys, issuer, audience, lifetime and token type.

Opt-in secp256k1 support for NCode.Identity.Jose — the secp256k1 elliptic curve (JWK crv "secp256k1") and the ES256K JWS signature algorithm (ECDSA over secp256k1 with SHA-256, RFC 8812), registered only where the platform's cryptography supports the curve.
The JSON value model of JOSE, OAuth and OpenID Connect for NCode.Identity: NumericDate coercion, claim sets as object graphs, strict claim reads on JsonElement and the family's JSON converters.
Google Cloud KMS key wrapper and remote key provider for NCode.Identity.

Contracts of CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE, RFC 9052 / 9053) for NCode.Identity: the labels and values of COSE maps, the algorithm, key type and curve vocabularies as registered data, the COSE_Key converter and the COSE serializer.
The contracts of NCode.Identity's cryptography service: random bytes and keys, hashing, and binary encodings as an open vocabulary of registered encoders.

First-class JSON Web Key (JWK) and JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) types for NCode.Identity, with JWK Thumbprint (RFC 7517 / 7638 / 9278) — a rich, serializable key model shared by the JOSE and Secrets libraries.
The registration builder of NCode.Identity: IServiceBuilder<TMarker> with library markers that check each registration's prerequisites at compile time, and strict configuration binding.
AWS KMS key wrapper and remote key provider for NCode.Identity.
The persistence contracts of NCode.Identity: stores, the store manager and its factory, paging, concurrency tokens, the store-neutral concurrency exception and post-commit work.
Endpoint registration of NCode.Identity on ASP.NET Core: endpoint providers, nested endpoint groups and endpoint dispositions.

Opt-in CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE, RFC 9052 / 9053) for NCode.Identity over System.Formats.Cbor: COSE_Sign1, COSE_Sign, COSE_Mac0, COSE_Mac, COSE_Encrypt0 and COSE_Encrypt with the family's JOSE algorithms and secret keys, and public COSE_Key and COSE_KeySet conversion.

Clean-room OKP (RFC 8037) support for NCode.Identity.Jose — an OKP secret-key type, EdDSA (Ed25519 / Ed448, RFC 8032) JWS signatures, and ECDH-ES key agreement over X25519 / X448 (RFC 7748), with no third-party cryptographic dependency.

The contracts of NCode.Identity's HTTP building blocks: the HTTP result executor and provider contracts, status-code and response-header support, HttpResultException, UriDescriptor and the front-channel endpoint metadata.
Contracts of CBOR Web Tokens (CWT, RFC 8392) for NCode.Identity: the claims set, the issuer and the validator with its fail-closed validation parameters.
The default implementation of NCode.Identity's settings: the setting descriptor and scope collections and their providers, setting collections and their factories, and the setting serializer.
The contracts of NCode.Identity's settings: setting descriptors, scopes, rules and merges, setting collections and their providers and factories, and the setting serializer.
The contracts of NCode.Identity's claims: the claims serializer with its serializable claim, identity and principal, and the claims service.

The HTTP building blocks of NCode.Identity on ASP.NET Core: page and response security (Content-Security-Policy, icon links, no-store), front-channel endpoint metadata, single-page bundles, form reads, and host hardening with Strict-Transport-Security, trusted forwarded headers, health probes and H…
The default implementation of NCode.Identity's cryptography service and its Base64Url, Base64 and hexadecimal binary encoders.

Opt-in Selective Disclosure for JWTs (SD-JWT, RFC 9901) for NCode.Identity.Jose — issuance with salted claim digests and decoys, holder presentation with Key Binding JWTs, verification with recursive disclosure resolution, and the SD-JWT VC profile (dc+sd-jwt, vct, status) as data.
The time values the JWT, CWT and OAuth specifications and NCode.Identity's settings define: NumericDate whole-second precision, the periods a timer accepts and the span between two instants.
Azure Key Vault key wrapper and remote key provider for NCode.Identity.
The default implementation of NCode.Identity's claims serializer and claims service.
Reads the public API of .NET assemblies with System.Reflection.Metadata, without loading them: types, members, signatures and attributes, as a model.
Compares the public API of two versions of .NET assemblies: what was added, removed or changed, the version bump semantic versioning calls for, and which changes affect code that uses them.
